reason: Worked example (PDF 133) quoting the Inn's rest result. The 2d6 HP roll belongs to character.settlement.rest (Rest and Recuperation, PDF 147); the example row does not ask for a roll of its own.
Day/night column label 'D2' means Day 2 in the sequence D1, N1, D2, N2 (PDF 133); it is not a die.
Day/night column label 'D3' means Day 3 in the sequence D1, N1, D2, N2 (PDF 133); it is not a die.
Day/night column label 'D4' means Day 4 in the sequence D1, N1, D2, N2 (PDF 133); it is not a die.
Moves the trap threshold of the existing door-trap d6 from Opening a Door or Chest (PDF 101) from 6 to 5-6 (PDF 104); the row does not ask for a roll of its own.
